limitations: Binary relevance at source-section record level; unsupported claims can have relevant background.
English-dominant small corpus; Chinese questions were authored for covered concepts.
Cases do not establish source entailment, legal correctness, or general adversarial robustness.
Developer-authored diagnostic set, not an independently blinded or held-out benchmark.
Recall/MRR are section relevance checks, not answer entailment or current-law validation.
Latency includes request-local document encoding; model load time is separate. No shared vector cache.
Additional sources require relabeling before quality metrics can be interpreted.
All-labeled-components coverage checks an annotator's source set, not semantic entailment; another citation's dated metadata can overlap a labeled component.
